evals.name: zh-cn-abstract
evals.prompt:
帮我看看这段摘要，下周要投稿了，导师说英文有问题但没说哪里

With the development of deep learning, more and more attention has been paid to defect detection of steel surface. In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of small defect detection, based on YOLOv8, an improved algorithm is put forward in this paper. Firstly, attention mechanism is introduced into backbone network, which can enhance feature extraction ability. Secondly, by this way of multi-scale fusion, the detection effect to small targets is improved. Experiment results show that the mAP of proposed method reaches 86.4%, which is 3.2% higher than original YOLOv8, and the speed reaches 92 FPS, the method realizes real-time detection. Obviously, the proposed method has a great application value in industrial field.
evals.expected_output: Sentence-by-sentence review in Simplified Chinese; flags with-development, more-and-more, article, front-loaded-purpose, put-forward, by-this-way, effect-to preposition, realize, comma splice, obviously, percentage points (3.2%), proposes concrete fixes; ends with a next step.

evals.name: zh-group-meeting-slides
evals.prompt:
下周组会要用英文讲一篇论文，这是我的slides文字和讲稿，帮我看看

Slide 1: Research Background
- With the development of LLM, more and more researches focus on long context
- Existing methods have high computation cost

Slide 2: Method
- Propose a sparse attention method
- Training the model on 4K tokens and then extending to 128K
- Evaluation on LongBench

Slide 3: Experiment
- The proposed method is the best in all datasets
- Speed is improved 3 times

Slide 4: Thank you for your listening!

讲稿：
Today I will introduce you a paper about long context LLM. Firstly, let me introduce the background. With the development of LLM, more and more researches focus on long context, however existing methods have high computation cost because the attention complexity is quadratic to the sequence length which makes it difficult to process very long documents in practical applications. In this paper, the authors put forward a sparse attention method. Everyone can see that the proposed method is the best in all datasets. That's all my report, welcome everyone to criticize and correct.
evals.expected_output: Uses notes-and-slides.md; slide-by-slide action titles; parallel bullets (Propose/Training/Evaluation); researches uncountable; with-development; overclaim attribution (authors report); 'improved 3 times' ambiguity; Thank you for your listening; script: introduce you, firstly let me introduce, long sentence split, put forward, everyone can see, That's all my report, criticize and correct; signposting allowed in speech.

evals.name: zh-paper-to-talk
evals.prompt:
下周四组会要讲我们自己的论文，下面是论文里结果部分的一段，帮我改成 2 页 slides 和对应的讲稿，我想学一下论文和讲稿的英文到底有什么区别

As shown in Table 3, the proposed method achieves an average F1 score of 0.873 on the three benchmark datasets, outperforming the strongest baseline [14] by 4.6 percentage points. Furthermore, the inference latency is reduced from 120 ms to 62 ms, respectively on GPU and CPU settings, which demonstrates the practicality of the method for real-time applications. However, it should be noted that the performance on the low-resource dataset (n = 312) is relatively limited, suggesting that the effectiveness of the proposed approach may depend on the availability of sufficient training data.
evals.expected_output: Convert mode via medium.md section 5: lists 3-5 changes; converts first part as model, hands over the rest (deadline next week); flags 'respectively' misuse (also ambiguous: 120 vs 62 not GPU/CPU pair?), citation spoken, numbers rounded in speech, signposting; slides with action titles; keeps hedge.
